stem: Aling Cora lends ₱8,000 to a neighbor at 6% simple interest per year. How much will the neighbor pay back in all after 9 months?
hints: In I = P × r × t, the time must be in years. How many years is 9 months?
9 months = 9/12 = 3/4 of a year. One year of interest is 6% of ₱8,000.
Multiply one year's interest by 3/4, then add it to the ₱8,000 borrowed.

solution.methodName: Simple interest: I = P × r × t

steps.action: Let A = the total amount paid back.
Change the time to years: 9 months = 9/12 = 3/4 year.
steps.why: The rate is per year, so the time must be in years.

steps.action: Amount paid back: A = P + I = ₱8,000 + ₱360 = ₱8,360.
steps.why: "In all" means the money borrowed plus the interest.

steps.action: Check: ₱360 is less than one year's interest of ₱480, which fits a loan shorter than a year. The neighbor pays back ₱8,360.

trapNotes.₱360: This is the interest only. "Pay back in all" means the money borrowed plus the interest.
trapNotes.₱8,480: This uses 1 full year of interest (₱480). The loan is for 9 months, which is 9/12 = 3/4 of a year.
trapNotes.₱12,320: This uses t = 9, as if 9 months were 9 years. Time must be in years: 9/12 = 3/4.
